data.description:
## Context / Problem

Follow-up to the incident fix in `90c7-c465-4037-42d5` (which fixed only Defect 1, the
`set -euo pipefail` dash-runtime failure in the `scanner-integration` make recipe). Two hardening
items were deferred from that incident fix and are captured here.

The `scanner-integration` job (added to `main` in `6125c5345f01`, Gerrit 2595, ticket aa9e) was a
newly-added REQUIRED Verified job. It (a) never executed on its own introducing change — the
Verified lane runs `gerrit-verify.yaml` from trusted `main`, which did not yet wire the lane, so
2595's `+1` was vacuous — and (b) fails on any patchset based before `6125c534` because its own
script is absent there.

**Defect 2 (quoted from a real job log).** Change 2608 (run 33837736047 job 100913937750):

```
python: can't open file '/home/runner/work/rebar/rebar/scripts/install_review_scanners.py':
[Errno 2] No such file or directory
```

`.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml` runs `scripts/install_review_scanners.py` and
`make scanner-integration` with no `[ -f ]` guard and no `# predates-gate-ok:` marker — the exact
invariant `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` owns, whose `GUARDED_WORKFLOWS` is a
hardcoded tuple that never listed `_scanner-integration.yml`.

## Approach

1. `.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml` — wrap the gate step in the canonical
   `[ -f scripts/install_review_scanners.py ]` guard emitting `change predates the gate`, and make
   the failure path actionable (name the pinned-scanner contract and print `make scanner-integration`).
2. `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` — derive `GUARDED_WORKFLOWS` from the
   `gerrit-verify.yaml`/`test.yml` local-`uses:` transitive closure instead of a hardcoded tuple,
   so a reusable workflow is inside the invariant the moment it is wired. Keep the current tuple as
   an asserted floor.
3. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` — add a STATIC bash-only-construct scan over every
   CI-reachable make recipe (flag `-o pipefail`, `[[`, indexed/associative arrays, `<<<`,
   `${var^}`/`${var,}`). NOTE: a parse-only `dash -n` check does NOT catch `set -o pipefail`
   (dash validates `set` option args at runtime, not parse), so the scan must be static-text or
   execute the leading `set` line under dash.

## Scope

- `.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml`
- `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py`
- `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`

## Testing

- Completeness: the derived guarded set contains every local `uses:` target reachable from
  `gerrit-verify.yaml`/`test.yml`; a new assertion fails when a lane member is omitted.
- Defect-seeded RED: drop the `-f` guard -> completeness test fails naming
  `_scanner-integration.yml`; restore `set -euo pipefail` in a recipe -> the static bash-construct
  scan flags the `pipefail` token; both pass after revert.
- Empty-tree: the guarded body run in an empty directory exits 0 and prints `change predates the gate`.
- Verification set: `make lint`, `make typecheck`,
  `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `_scanner-integration.yml` gate step is guarded so a change lacking the scanner script skips
      cleanly (prints `change predates the gate`), not fails. Checked by the empty-tree test.
- [ ] `test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` derives its workflow set from the lane closure; a new
      coverage assertion fails when a wired lane is omitted. Checked by running the module and by
      the seeded-omission RED.
- [ ] The Defect-1 class is pinned by a STATIC bash-only-construct scan (not a parse-only check);
      restoring `set -euo pipefail` makes it fail naming the recipe. Checked by the seeded RED.
- [ ] No new mechanism beyond the guarded workflow step (justified with a `# mechanism-ok:` marker
      if the ratchet flags it). Checked by `make lint`.
data.title: Close the scanner-integration vacuous-vote escape: predates-gate guard + lane-derived parity coverage
